apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: staging-hitokoto
spec:
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 8000
  selector:
    app: hitokoto-team
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: staging-hitokoto
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: hitokoto-team
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: hitokoto-team
    spec:
      containers:
      - env:
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              key: DB_PASSWORD
              name: team-secret
        image: ghcr.io/container-nyumon/hitokoto:2.1
        name: app
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          runAsNonRoot: true
          seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault
